privacy.residencyBody: Your data is stored in London, United Kingdom, with nightly encrypted backups.
privacy.securityBody: TLS in transit, encrypted at rest, and row-level security so no other company can ever see your data.
privacy.rolesBody: You decide what is processed. Matrix Infotech Ltd acts as your processor under our DPA.
privacy.exportHint: Download everything your company holds in MatrixFleet as a machine-readable JSON file (GDPR Articles 15 & 20).
privacy.adminOnly: Only owners and admins can export company data.

retention.invoices: Invoices are kept for as long as your account exists, so you can meet tax record rules (6 years UK, up to 10 years in some EU countries).
retention.jobs: Jobs, proof-of-delivery signatures and photos are kept until you delete them or close your account.
retention.gps: Driver GPS positions are only recorded while a driver shares their location. Location history older than 90 days is deleted automatically.
retention.checks: Vehicle walkaround checks are kept so you can evidence roadworthiness to the DVSA and other authorities.
retention.audit: The audit log records who changed what, for accountability.
retention.backups: When you delete your company, data is removed immediately and disappears from backups within 14 days.

privacy.legalLinks: Read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <dpa>Data Processing Agreement</dpa>.
privacy.dangerHint: These actions are permanent and cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteMeBody: Erases your login, removes your email from the audit log and deletes your GPS history. Business records you created (jobs, invoices) stay with the company.
privacy.deleteOrgBody: Cancels your subscription, deletes your billing profile at Stripe and permanently erases all jobs, customers, invoices, drivers, vehicles and files — and the logins of everyone in the company who isn't a member of another company.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: A record of important actions in your workspace.

einvoicing.title: Saudi e-invoicing (ZATCA Phase 2)
einvoicing.intro: Saudi VAT-registered companies must issue tax invoices through ZATCA's Fatoora platform. Once connected, MatrixFleet signs every invoice, sends business invoices for clearance and reports consumer invoices automatically.
einvoicing.notConnectedBody: Until you connect, Saudi invoices carry the basic QR code only (phase 1). Connect before your ZATCA integration deadline.
einvoicing.testWarning: This is a test connection. Invoices are not legally submitted. Connect to Production before issuing real invoices.
einvoicing.notConfigured: E-invoicing is not switched on for this MatrixFleet installation yet. Please contact MatrixFleet support.
einvoicing.missingBody: ZATCA needs these details on every tax invoice:

field.vat_number: VAT number (15 digits, starts and ends with 3)

einvoicing.connectBody: Enter the one-time code from the Fatoora portal. MatrixFleet creates your signing key, runs ZATCA's six compliance checks and activates the connection. This takes about a minute.
einvoicing.environmentHint: Use Simulation first to test with ZATCA's simulation portal, then Production.
einvoicing.howTitle: How to get the one-time code
einvoicing.how1: Sign in to the Fatoora portal with your ZATCA (ERAD) account.
einvoicing.how2: Choose “Onboard new solution unit/device” (use the Simulation portal for testing).
einvoicing.how3: Generate one code (OTP) and copy it.
einvoicing.how4: Paste it here within one hour and press Connect.
einvoicing.howNote: Your private signing key is created on our server and stored encrypted. It never leaves MatrixFleet.
